summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MicroXisto PWA app. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all major features including login, navigation tabs, Comparativo section, Planejamento with Estágio dropdown, Estudo de Mercado CRUD, and Admin Panel with maintenance mode toggle and Excel export.
seed_data_creation: Test market study record exists: empresa='Test Co', produto='Product A'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features implemented and working. Backend APIs tested via pytest. Frontend tested via Playwright. Key features verified: 1) Login with admin credentials works 2) All 6 navigation tabs visible (Início, Tecnologias, Culturas, Planejamento, Comparativo, Estudo de Mercado) 3) Comparativo allows viewing competitor without MicroXisto product selected 4) Planejamento has Estágio dropdown for each product 5) Estudo de Mercado has full CRUD with R$/ha auto-calculation 6) Admin Panel has Manutenção toggle and Estudo Mercado Excel export

login_flow.details: Admin login with agrofialho@gmail.com / adm@123 works correctly

navigation_tabs.details: All 6 tabs visible: Início, Tecnologias, Culturas, Planejamento, Comparativo, Estudo de Mercado

comparativo_section.details: Ver Concorrente button works with only competitor selected (no MicroXisto product required). Shows competitor details and MicroXisto product recommendations.

planejamento_estagio.details: Estágio dropdown appears for each product with options. Same product can be added multiple times.

estudo_mercado_crud.details: Create, Read, Update, Delete all working. R$/ha auto-calculated (dose_ha * valor). Form has all fields: Empresa, Produto, Dose/ha, Valor, Tipo de Venda, Estado

admin_maintenance_mode.details: Manutenção tab shows status and Ativar/Desativar Manutenção button

admin_estudo_mercado_export.details: Estudo Mercado admin tab has 'Baixar Excel' button for export

api_market_studies_crud.details: All CRUD endpoints working: POST, GET, PUT, DELETE /api/market-studies
